gates.name: coverage-floor
gates.command: go test ./... -coverprofile=.regulus/coverage.out >/dev/null && go tool cover -func=.regulus/coverage.out | tail -n1

gates.name: mutation
gates.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d); git archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$tmp" && cd "$tmp" && "$HOME/go/bin/gremlins" unleash ./internal/receipts --threshold-efficacy=70; rc=$?; rm -rf "$tmp"; exit $rc
